title: Thermodynamic formalism for hyperbolic random dynamical systems
summary: We develop thermodynamic formalism for random Anosov maps and uniformly Hölder random potentials. We assume uniform fibre hyperbolicity given by deterministic invariant cone fields, a one-dimensional stable direction, and a fibrewise mixing condition whose mixing time may depend on the base point. To do so, we construct adapted projective cones for the random Perron--Frobenius cocycle and prove that the cocycle contracts the associated Hilbert projective metrics.
